reserveReview.rationale: The live transparency dashboard reported $134.69M of reserves against $133.67M of thUSD supply on 2026-09-29: actively deployed positions of $98.72M gold carry (73.3% of total reserves) and $35.85M thBILL (26.61%), plus $124k of redemption liquidity split 83.92% USDC and 16.08% USDT (0.09% combined). The gold carry slice is modeled as one position because Theo does not publish its internal split between gold leases, futures margin, and Treasury collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Theo transparency dashboard reserve composition read on 2026-09-29
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The internal composition of the gold carry position (lease book versus CME futures margin versus T-bill collateral, and MG999 versus other lessees) is not published; the dashboard reports the position only as an aggregate. The reserve-side split of staked versus unstaked backing is likewise not published.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Mint collateral is received by the 4-of-5 thUSD Cash Wallet Safe, and the strategy spreads custody across Standard Chartered/Libeara (gold side), a US-regulated Fortune-500 FCM holding CME margin in CFTC-segregated customer funds, and Wellington-managed Treasury funds. Provider share percentages, segregation, and rehypothecation terms are not published; the FCM is not named. Bankruptcy remoteness is structured at the MG999 fund level (gold outside lessee estates, insured and reinsured with a 20% first-loss buffer), not evidenced for every reserve leg.
